shock.label: EXP-11: геополитический ценовой шок Core/Flex +25% в 2038–2039
notes: TEAM illustration, not an empirically calibrated geopolitical forecast or probability.
Apply once to variable prices on an isolated case copy; BASE demand and physical supply.
Fixed BASE P2z/P3/P4 plans; no replanning, outages, delays, refunds or invented damages.
Prices revert to BASE in 2040. Reservation rates, TOP shares, CAPEX and OPEX are unchanged.
The 25% magnitude and 2038–2039 window match the price component of MANDATORY_STRESS only for comparability; no other mandatory-stress factors are applied.
R2's selection by advance-adapted mandatory-stress cost is unchanged.

changes.justification: Illustrative geopolitical surcharge on Earth-Core/Earth-Flex procurement only; no decomposition of the organizer's aggregate price is assumed.

method.case_copy: case/*.csv unchanged; shock.yaml applies the annual price overlay once
method.fixed: orders, reservations, investments, opening stock and demand allocation
method.costs: variable procurement surcharge only; reservation, TOP rules, CAPEX and OPEX unchanged
method.reserve: annual opening stock minus 45-day requirement; all years reported
method.service: minimum annual total/critical service; failure includes both hard and guideline violations (97%/99%)
method.decision: R2 selection by advance-adapted mandatory-stress cost is unchanged
method.limits: illustrative price-only shock; no outages, empirical probabilities, replanning or 2041+ claim

discount_rate_real.justification: Real discount rate for long-lived infrastructure with technology risk. Not given by the organizer. Used identically for all alternatives; sensitivity 0–12 % in experiments/run_sensitivity.py.

discount_t0_year.justification: Annual cash flows dated at the start of each year; PV factor = 1/(1+r)^(year-2035).

discount_timing.justification: Annual cash flows dated at the start of each year (exponent year-2035); mid/end-year conventions available and applied identically to all alternatives.

prep_period_start.justification: Earliest order date of the preparatory period (Earth-Core needs 12 months before 2035-01).

lead_time_policy.justification: Conservative end of the organizer lead-time ranges (Earth-New 24 months, ISRU 2 months).

weeks_per_month.justification: 365/12/7. Week lead times converted with ceil(weeks/4.345) -> Emergency 6 weeks = 2 months.

days_per_month.justification: 365/12; day-denominated lead times converted with ceil.

zbo_commissioning_lag_months.justification: Case gives no ZBO build time; modernization active from the CAPEX month. Varied in sensitivity.

earth_new_post_commissioning_lead_months.justification: The 18–24 month Earth-New lead time is read as decision-to-first-delivery; orders are placed during preparation.

isru_commissioning_month.justification: Lunar-ISRU available from 2038 once CAPEX is financed before 2038.

source_investment_link.justification: Earth-New capacity requires the exercised option; Lunar-ISRU requires the pilot CAPEX.

storage_investment_link.justification: ZBO modernization switches the active storage mode (capacity 120 t, losses 1.2 %, OPEX 12/yr).

emergency_base_share_threshold.justification: Emergency counts as the base channel in a year when its ordered volume exceeds 20 % of that year's demand.

holding_cost_averaging.justification: Average physical stock per month = (I_start + I_end)/2; holding = 0.72 x average x 1/12.

storage_capacity_check.justification: Hard violation when end-of-month stock > capacity; warning when stock after inflow (before withdrawals) > capacity.

emergency_reserve_equivalence.justification: Contracted Emergency reserve counts only if stock covers demand during the 6-week lead time and reserved Emergency capacity >= R_y.

opening_stock_reservation_years.justification: The preparatory-period purchase pays the source reservation rate on the purchased tonnage for one year; booked in 2035.

prep_period_holding_charged.justification: Holding cost charged from 2035-01; storage time in the preparatory period (< 1 month) is not charged.

intra_year_demand_profile.justification: Organizer convention — uniform demand within the year, 365 days.

exp10_demand_max.justification: EXP-10 only: uniform U(0, value), multiplying both mandatory-stress total and critical demand in 2038-2040. One persistent draw per realization; independent of ISRU and price in the primary model. Diagnostic shares the demand uniform with ISRU. Range brackets EXP-08's 1% target; illustrative conditional uncertainty, not calibrated organizer probabilities. Core ignores this key.

exp10_isru_reduction_max.unit: additional relative reduction of actual ISRU delivery share
exp10_isru_reduction_max.justification: EXP-10 only: uniform U(0, value), multiplying mandatory-stress ISRU shares by 1-s in 2038-2040. One persistent draw; reliability is not multiplied again. Independent primary model, comonotonic demand/ISRU diagnostic; price independent in both. No random Core capacity outages are included.

exp10_price_half_range.unit: relative variable-price deviation from mandatory stress
exp10_price_half_range.justification: EXP-10 only: uniform U(-value, value), one common persistent price draw for Core and Flex in 2038-2039, independent of physical factors. Multiplies the existing 1.25 stress multiplier. Illustrative economic range without empirical calibration; not a capacity or delivery shock.
